_about: Every repo's lanes (dev -> beta -> main): how it runs locally, where beta and live are, and how a push deploys. Read by tools/lanes/lanes.mjs (dev.bat, deploy-beta.bat, deploy-prod.bat, status.bat, links.bat, sync.bat in each repo) and docs/lanes.md. Keys are repo folder names under C:\Projects. Beta sites of games are behind Studio sign-in.

hawkesgen.title: Hawkes Gen
hawkesgen.deploys: Push beta: GitHub Actions builds the image and deploys Cloud Run gen-beta. Push main: the same for gen (live). Health-checked, rolled back if unhealthy.

hawkesstudio.title: Hawkes Studio
hawkesstudio.deploys: Push beta: GitHub Actions deploys Cloud Run studio-beta and job studio-agent-beta (on gen-beta). Push main: studio and studio-agent (live, with the 5 AM daily run).

hawkesnet.title: Hawkes Net
hawkesnet.deploys: Push beta: the beta Net VM (hawkes-net-beta, keys checked with gen-beta) pulls it on its timer. Push main: the live Net VM (hawkes-net) pulls it on its timer.

hawkesgenwebsite.title: Hawkes Gen portal (hawkesgames.com)
hawkesgenwebsite.deploys: Push beta: GitHub Actions deploys Firebase project hawkes-staging (beta.hawkesgames.com, on gen-beta and beta Net). Push main: Firebase hawkes-prod (live).

hawkesbiomedicalnew.title: Hawkes Biomedical (corporate site)
hawkesbiomedicalnew.deploys: Push beta: Studio publishes the beta site. Push main: GitHub Pages publishes it live.

phoriginswebsite.title: PH Origins
phoriginswebsite.deploys: Push beta: Studio builds and publishes the beta site and playtests it. Push main: its pages.yml builds and GitHub Pages publishes it live.

doseofdestructionwebsite.title: Dose Of Destruction
doseofdestructionwebsite.deploys: Push beta: Studio builds and publishes the beta site and playtests it. Push main: its pages.yml builds and GitHub Pages publishes it live.

icanbeaiwebsite.title: I Can Be
icanbeaiwebsite.deploys: Push beta: Studio publishes the beta site and playtests it. Push main: GitHub Pages publishes it live.

imaginelivetvwebsite.title: Imagine Live TV
imaginelivetvwebsite.deploys: Push beta: Studio publishes the beta site and playtests it. Push main: GitHub Pages publishes it live.

sickofitgame-unity.title: Sick Of It (Unity source)
sickofitgame-unity.deploys: Push beta plus a build-* tag (deploy-beta does both): Gen builds that commit on Cloud Run and pushes Game/v<n> to sickofitgamewebsite's beta; Studio playtests it. Push main: Studio publishes that build to sickofitgamewebsite's main (GitHub Pages, live).

sickofitgamewebsite.title: Sick Of It (website)
sickofitgamewebsite.deploys: Builds arrive on beta from sickofitgame-unity (build tags). Push main: GitHub Pages publishes it live (Studio does this when the game goes live).

YoobaLand.deploys: Push beta plus a build-* tag (deploy-beta does both): Gen builds that commit on Cloud Run and pushes Game/ to YoobaLandGame's beta; Studio playtests it. Push main: Studio publishes that build to YoobaLandGame's main (GitHub Pages, live).

YoobaLandGame.title: Yooba Land (website)
YoobaLandGame.deploys: Builds arrive on beta from YoobaLand (build tags). Push main: GitHub Pages publishes it live (Studio does this when the game goes live).
